arithmetic_mean_across_annual_levels.reason: ordered annual population levels are not interchangeable random samples; mean is a window descriptor, not timeless distribution or expectation

coverage.reason: compact completeness metric with explicit expected-slot denominator; useful for validation gates and comparability when scope is explicit

first_and_last_observations.reason: true endpoint facts, but not trend descriptors; useful mainly as window anchors

median_across_annual_levels.reason: valid finite-set statistic but limited reusable meaning for monotone or near-monotone level series

min_max_with_periods.reason: deterministic extrema are useful for bounded windows but can invite implicit trend/significance claims

observation_and_missingness_counts.reason: direct evidence-quality and completeness facts; low interpretation risk; useful across fixtures

population_standard_deviation_across_ann.reason: valid finite-window dispersion descriptor, but easily mistaken for uncertainty, volatility, or distributional property
